description: This Java class 'MafValue' encapsulates a measure of Mass Air Flow (MAF) sensor value with methods for creation from string, retrieval, and string representation.

classes.name: MafValue
classes.description: Represents a MAF sensor value with a final integer 'value' and utility methods for creation and representation.

methods.name: MafValue
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MafValue object with an integer 'value'.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the MAF measurement.

methods.name: valueOf
methods.description: Static factory method to create a MafValue instance from a string input, parsing it into an integer using a utility method.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString to provide a string representation of the MafValue object.
